piece.name: Cakewalk Strut
piece.title: Cakewalk Strut
piece.notes: Test piece for cakewalk syncopation. First draft used rhythm:'pattern' with a hand-authored 3+3+2 onset grid -- but generator.py confirmed rhythm:'pattern' always couples bass to the identical onset grid (bypassing bass_style dispatch entirely, per bass.py's rhythm_events_override path), which would have made bass syncopate in unison with the melody instead of staying steady underneath it -- the opposite of the intended effect. Fixed by using rhythm:'free' + groove:'broken', the engine's own built-in 3+3+2 tresillo template (its docstring literally says 'Afro-Cuban tresillo' -- same rhythmic lineage as cakewalk). groove only threads into melody's own generation path; bass_style keeps running its own independent dispatch untouched, so root_fifth/pulse/root_only actually stay steady and on the beat as designed. swing stays 0.0 throughout -- cakewalk/ragtime syncopation is straight eighths with shifted accents, not a triplet shuffle. ABA form (intro, strain A, strain B, strain A reprise, outro) mirrors real published cakewalk sheet music structure. One counterpoint voice in strain B only, for a light countermelody.

intro.name: intro
intro.notes: Vamp -- establishes the steady march pulse before the syncopated tune enters properly in strain A.

strain_a.name: strain_a
strain_a.notes: Main strain. root_fifth bass stays flatly on the beat while the melody's 3+3+2 grouping cuts across it -- that tension is the actual cakewalk effect, not a trick layered on top of it.

strain_b.name: strain_b
strain_b.notes: Contrasting strain -- bass moves to pulse for a touch more insistence, still steady/unsyncopated. One light countermelody above, the way a period brass-band arrangement might carry a second voice.

breakdown.name: breakdown
breakdown.notes: The eye of the storm, same move as Xanadu's breakdown before its recap. No groove (syncopation drops out entirely, not just thins), no counterpoint, pedal bass, high rest_probability. This is the one place in the piece everything actually stops -- earns the reprise's rebuild instead of just continuing at the same density.

strain_a_reprise.name: strain_a_reprise
strain_a_reprise.notes: Return of strain A -- classic ABA parlor-piece structure. No counterpoint here, mirrors the original strain's simplicity. arc changed from plateau to build so it rebuilds out of the breakdown instead of resuming at full density with no sense of return.
